title: Sam's Weekend
text:
Sam likes sports. He plays football with his friends on Saturday. They play in the park near his house. Sam is a good player.

On Sunday, Sam plays the guitar. He practises for one hour. His sister likes to sing with him. They have fun together.

questions.text: What sport does Sam play on Saturday?
What instrument does Sam play on Sunday?
How does Sam probably feel about his hobbies?
Why do Sam and his sister have fun together?
options: They sing and play music together

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people go to relax or play
a person who takes part in a game or sport
a musical instrument with six strings that you play with your fingers

paragraph_translations: A Sam le gusta el deporte. Juega al fútbol con sus amigos los sábados. Ellos juegan en el parque cerca de su casa. Sam es un buen jugador.
El domingo, Sam toca la guitarra. Practica durante una hora. A su hermana le gusta cantar con él. Ellos se divierten juntos.
